starters.name: Everyday Assistant
starters.summary: Routes everyday questions, writing, analysis, and documents.

lanes.name: Quick help
lanes.description: Brief, self-contained requests: definitions, factual questions, short summaries, formatting, and small text transformations. Excludes multi-step decisions and long source material.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast, low-cost target.

lanes.name: Deep analysis
lanes.description: Problems that require several reasoning steps, trade-off analysis, scenario comparison, root-cause thinking, or a recommendation backed by an explicit rationale.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong reasoning target.

lanes.name: Draft and rewrite
lanes.description: Creating or revising messages, emails, notes, and short documents. Includes tone changes, proofreading, clarity edits, and audience-specific rewrites.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong writing target.

lanes.name: Long documents
lanes.description: Requests centered on long reports, transcripts, manuals, or several supplied documents, including summarization, comparison, and question answering across the material.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-context target.

lanes.name: Structured extraction
lanes.description: Extracting named fields, entities, dates, requirements, or action items from text and returning tables, checklists, schemas, or valid JSON.
lanes.target_hint: Best with reliable structured output.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable general-purpose target.

starters.name: Writing and Editing Studio
starters.summary: Routes editing, rewriting, long-form work, and persuasive copy.

lanes.name: Correct and tighten
lanes.description: Line editing existing text for grammar, spelling, clarity, repetition, concision, and sentence flow while preserving the original voice and meaning.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast writing target.

lanes.name: Rewrite voice
lanes.description: Recasting supplied text for a different tone, reading level, audience, point of view, or format without changing the underlying message.
lanes.target_hint: Best with strong voice and tone control.

lanes.name: Long-form drafting
lanes.description: Developing new articles, reports, guides, newsletters, documentation, or other multi-section pieces from a brief, notes, or an outline.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong long-form writing target.

lanes.name: Persuasive writing
lanes.description: Copy intended to influence a decision or action, such as proposals, opinion pieces, fundraising appeals, landing pages, and calls to action.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a persuasive writing target.

lanes.name: Summarize and adapt
lanes.description: Condensing existing material or adapting it for another channel, length, or audience, such as turning a report into an executive brief or a talk into a post.
lanes.target_hint: Best with strong long-context handling.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a balanced writing target.

starters.name: Research and Evidence Desk
starters.summary: Routes orientation, evidence, criticism, methods, and source analysis.

lanes.name: Quick orientation
lanes.description: Early-stage research that needs definitions, key concepts, major viewpoints, search terms, or a map of questions before deeper investigation begins.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast general target.

lanes.name: Evidence synthesis
lanes.description: Combining findings from multiple sources to identify consensus, disagreements, recurring themes, evidence strength, and unresolved uncertainty.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong research target.

lanes.name: Critical review
lanes.description: Stress-testing a claim, argument, paper, or proposal for hidden assumptions, weak evidence, alternative explanations, contradictions, and missing perspectives.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful reasoning target.

lanes.name: Methods and numbers
lanes.description: Research design and quantitative work: sampling, controls, measurement, statistical tests, calculations, uncertainty, and interpretation of numerical results.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a quantitative reasoning target.

lanes.name: Source analysis
lanes.description: Close reading of supplied papers, reports, transcripts, or document sets to compare methods, claims, quotations, evidence, and conclusions across sources.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-context target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable research target.

starters.name: Software Delivery Copilot
starters.summary: Routes coding, debugging, design, review, tests, and documentation.

lanes.name: Code help
lanes.description: Contained programming work such as generating a function, explaining a code block, using an API, translating between languages, or answering a focused implementation question.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast coding target.

lanes.name: Debugging
lanes.description: Broken or unexpected behavior: exceptions, stack traces, failing tests, regressions, incorrect output, environment conflicts, and requests to find and fix the cause.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a coding target with strong reasoning.

lanes.name: Architecture
lanes.description: System-level design involving components, interfaces, data flow, persistence, scaling, migrations, deployment boundaries, or trade-offs that span multiple modules.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a deep reasoning target.

lanes.name: Review and security
lanes.description: Reviewing existing code or configuration for correctness, security flaws, performance risks, concurrency problems, unsafe assumptions, and maintainability issues.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful code review target.

lanes.name: Tests and documentation
lanes.description: Producing unit or integration tests, test plans, examples, API documentation, README content, code comments, release notes, and developer handoff material.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a dependable coding target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable coding target.

starters.name: Data and Spreadsheet Analyst
starters.summary: Routes spreadsheets, SQL, statistics, charts, and forecasts.

lanes.name: Spreadsheet work
lanes.description: Workbook tasks involving formulas, lookups, pivots, sorting, cleanup, deduplication, validation, joins, and organizing data across sheets.
lanes.target_hint: Best with strong structured-data handling.

lanes.name: SQL and transformation
lanes.description: Database and pipeline work: writing SQL, shaping tables, defining schemas, joining datasets, building transformations, and checking data quality rules.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a coding and data target.

lanes.name: Statistical analysis
lanes.description: Questions about distributions, experiments, confidence intervals, significance, correlation, regression, sampling bias, and what results do or do not support.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a quantitative reasoning target.

lanes.name: Visualization
lanes.description: Choosing charts, designing dashboards, explaining trends and anomalies, and turning observed data into a clear visual or written narrative.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an analytical writing target.

lanes.name: Forecasting
lanes.description: Future-looking estimates based on assumptions, scenarios, trends, sensitivities, ranges, and uncertainty, including what changes under best- and worst-case conditions.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong reasoning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable analytical target.

starters.name: Meetings and Follow-ups
starters.summary: Routes meeting preparation, notes, actions, and follow-up messages.

lanes.name: Meeting preparation
lanes.description: Work done before a meeting: agendas, objectives, participant briefs, discovery questions, decision points, pre-reads, and talking points.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast planning target.

lanes.name: Transcript summary
lanes.description: Turning meeting notes or transcripts into a faithful recap of themes, decisions, disagreements, open questions, and important context.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-context target.

lanes.name: Actions and owners
lanes.description: Pulling commitments from meeting material and listing each task with its owner, due date, dependency, status, and required follow-up.
lanes.target_hint: Best with reliable structured output.

lanes.name: Follow-up writing
lanes.description: Post-meeting communication, including recap emails, stakeholder updates, announcements, decision confirmations, and requests for missing information.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong communication target.

lanes.name: Difficult conversations
lanes.description: Messages for conflict, corrective feedback, negotiation, refusal, apology, or other sensitive situations where wording and emotional tone matter.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful writing target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable communication target.

starters.name: Marketing Campaign Studio
starters.summary: Routes campaign planning, content, social posts, email, and conversion copy.

lanes.name: Campaign strategy
lanes.description: High-level campaign decisions about audience, positioning, offer, message, channels, sequence, budget, objectives, and how success will be measured.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong marketing reasoning target.

lanes.name: Content and SEO
lanes.description: Search-oriented content such as keyword briefs, article outlines, educational pages, topic clusters, metadata, and long-form pieces built around reader intent.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-form content target.

lanes.name: Social content
lanes.description: Platform-specific posts, threads, captions, content calendars, hooks, and short variations designed for social feeds and community engagement.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast creative writing target.

lanes.name: Email lifecycle
lanes.description: Email sequences tied to a customer stage or event: welcome, nurture, onboarding, launch, retention, renewal, win-back, and re-engagement.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a persuasive writing target.

lanes.name: Conversion copy
lanes.description: Performance copy for ads, landing pages, product pages, headlines, offers, forms, and calls to action where the goal is a measurable response.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a concise persuasive target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a brand-aware marketing target.

starters.name: Visual Content Studio
starters.summary: Routes photos, illustrations, mockups, diagrams, and image edits.

lanes.name: Photography
lanes.description: Image requests seeking photographic realism, believable people or products, natural materials, camera-like composition, lighting, depth of field, and editorial scenes.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong photorealistic image target.

lanes.name: Illustration
lanes.description: Drawn or stylized artwork such as characters, posters, editorial graphics, icons, comics, storybook scenes, flat art, or painterly compositions.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong illustration target.

lanes.name: Product mockups
lanes.description: Presentation images for packaging, merchandise, devices, app screens, signage, and products placed in realistic branded or commercial settings.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an image target that handles product details well.

lanes.name: Diagrams and infographics
lanes.description: Visual explanations that depend on labeled structure: processes, systems, timelines, comparisons, maps, charts, technical diagrams, and infographics.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an image target that handles text and layout well.

lanes.name: Edits and variations
lanes.description: Changes to an existing image, including removing or replacing elements, extending the canvas, restyling, recoloring, cleanup, and generating close alternatives.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an image target that supports editing.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable general image target.

starters.name: Translation and Localization Desk
starters.summary: Routes translation, product localization, transcreation, terminology, and language review.

lanes.name: Direct translation
lanes.description: Faithful translation between named languages with meaning, facts, structure, and established terminology preserved as closely as the target language allows.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong multilingual target.

lanes.name: Product localization
lanes.description: Adapting interface copy, help text, notifications, onboarding, and product messages to local conventions, space limits, and expected terminology.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a multilingual product-writing target.

lanes.name: Transcreation
lanes.description: Recreating slogans, campaign copy, humor, emotion, and persuasive intent for another culture when a literal translation would lose the effect.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a creative multilingual target.

lanes.name: Terminology work
lanes.description: Building, cleaning, or applying a glossary; resolving term choices; enforcing approved product, legal, or technical vocabulary across content.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise multilingual target.

lanes.name: Language review
lanes.description: Reviewing translated content for mistranslations, omissions, grammar, unnatural phrasing, inconsistent terms, locale formatting, and text left in the source language.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful multilingual review target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable multilingual target.

starters.name: Presentation Builder
starters.summary: Routes presentation structure, slide copy, data stories, notes, and rehearsal.

lanes.name: Narrative and outline
lanes.description: Shaping the presentation before slide writing: audience, objective, argument, story arc, section order, evidence, and the decision or action at the end.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong planning target.

lanes.name: Slide copy
lanes.description: Writing concise slide titles, bullets, labels, captions, and calls to action that can be understood quickly without dense paragraph text.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a concise writing target.

lanes.name: Data storytelling
lanes.description: Selecting and sequencing findings, charts, and metrics so the audience understands what changed, why it matters, and what conclusion the data supports.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an analytical writing target.

lanes.name: Speaker notes
lanes.description: Expanding slides into spoken explanations, transitions, examples, timing cues, and reminders that support delivery without duplicating the slide text.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a natural long-form writing target.

lanes.name: Review and rehearsal
lanes.description: Critiquing a deck for logic, clarity, pacing, evidence, and visual overload, then preparing likely audience questions, objections, and concise answers.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a critical reasoning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable presentation target.

starters.name: Customer Support Triage
starters.summary: Routes quick answers, troubleshooting, billing, complaints, and escalations.

lanes.name: Quick answers
lanes.description: Routine product questions, known FAQs, setup guidance, feature explanations, and simple how-to requests that have a direct documented answer.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast, low-cost support target.

lanes.name: Technical troubleshooting
lanes.description: Reports of errors, broken behavior, failed integrations, connectivity problems, or incorrect results that require diagnostic questions and recovery steps.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a technical reasoning target.

lanes.name: Account and billing
lanes.description: Requests about login access, plans, subscriptions, invoices, charges, refunds, account ownership, entitlements, and changes to customer records.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise support target.

lanes.name: Complaints and recovery
lanes.description: Frustrated or dissatisfied customer messages that call for acknowledgment, de-escalation, ownership, apology, and a clear path to resolution.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful communication target.

lanes.name: Escalation handoff
lanes.description: Preparing an internal escalation with customer impact, timeline, evidence, reproduction steps, attempted fixes, current status, urgency, and the next responsible team.
lanes.target_hint: Best with reliable structured output.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable customer support target.

starters.name: Sales and Proposal Desk
starters.summary: Routes account research, outreach, discovery, objections, and proposals.

lanes.name: Account research
lanes.description: Building an account brief from supplied material: organization, market, people, current tools, likely priorities, recent changes, and relevant risks or opportunities.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong research target.

lanes.name: Outreach
lanes.description: Writing personalized prospecting emails, connection notes, follow-ups, and meeting requests intended to start or reopen a sales conversation.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a concise persuasive writing target.

lanes.name: Discovery
lanes.description: Preparing discovery calls, qualification questions, pain-point hypotheses, stakeholder maps, and notes that uncover needs, authority, urgency, and decision criteria.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a thoughtful sales target.

lanes.name: Objection handling
lanes.description: Responding to concerns about price, timing, implementation, trust, competition, procurement, or fit without turning the answer into a full proposal.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a persuasive reasoning target.

lanes.name: Proposals and RFPs
lanes.description: Longer formal sales documents such as proposals, scopes, value cases, executive summaries, security responses, and structured RFP or RFI answers.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-context target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable sales writing target.

starters.name: Product Management Hub
starters.summary: Routes feedback, product definition, priorities, experiments, and launches.

lanes.name: Feedback synthesis
lanes.description: Clustering interviews, tickets, reviews, and requests into themes, user problems, frequency, severity, unmet needs, and supporting evidence.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-context target.

lanes.name: Product definition
lanes.description: Defining a problem and intended behavior through briefs, requirements, user stories, flows, constraints, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise product-writing target.

lanes.name: Prioritization
lanes.description: Comparing candidate work by user impact, strategic fit, effort, risk, confidence, urgency, dependencies, and the cost of delay.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong reasoning target.

lanes.name: Metrics and experiments
lanes.description: Designing hypotheses, success metrics, event definitions, baselines, experiments, guardrails, sample considerations, and decision rules.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an analytical reasoning target.

lanes.name: Launch and release
lanes.description: Planning rollout stages, readiness checks, release notes, enablement, communication, monitoring, feedback collection, and rollback conditions.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a structured planning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable product reasoning target.

starters.name: Project Delivery Office
starters.summary: Routes plans, status, risks, decisions, and retrospectives.

lanes.name: Planning
lanes.description: Turning an objective into scope, milestones, work packages, estimates, owners, sequencing, dependencies, and a delivery schedule.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong planning target.

lanes.name: Status reporting
lanes.description: Communicating current progress, completed work, changes, blockers, decisions, confidence, and the next reporting period in a concise update.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a concise structured writing target.

lanes.name: Risks and dependencies
lanes.description: Identifying what could derail delivery, including probability, impact, warning signs, mitigations, dependencies, contingencies, and accountable owners.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful reasoning target.

lanes.name: Decision support
lanes.description: Framing a project decision with options, constraints, trade-offs, evidence, recommendation, dissent, and a record of what was decided.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong reasoning target.

lanes.name: Retrospectives
lanes.description: Looking back on delivery outcomes to separate symptoms from contributing factors, capture lessons, and assign concrete improvement actions.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an analytical writing target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable planning target.

starters.name: People Operations Assistant
starters.summary: Routes policies, hiring, interviews, onboarding, and development.
starters.notice: Review decisions about people before acting on them.

lanes.name: Policies and guidance
lanes.description: Explaining supplied workplace policies, benefits, leave rules, procedures, and employee processes in plain language without inventing policy.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful business-writing target.

lanes.name: Roles and hiring
lanes.description: Creating job descriptions, role expectations, hiring scorecards, candidate messages, and structured criteria for an open position.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a clear people-writing target.

lanes.name: Interview preparation
lanes.description: Designing interview plans, behavioral and technical questions, evaluation rubrics, interviewer assignments, and evidence-based debrief prompts.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a structured reasoning target.

lanes.name: Onboarding
lanes.description: Building first-day, first-week, and role ramp-up plans with access, training, introductions, checkpoints, responsibilities, and manager follow-through.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a planning and writing target.

lanes.name: Feedback and development
lanes.description: Writing performance feedback, goals, coaching notes, growth plans, recognition, and clear messages for difficult employee conversations.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful communication target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a careful people operations target.

starters.name: IT Help Desk
starters.summary: Routes user help, devices, networks, access, automation, and documentation.

lanes.name: User assistance
lanes.description: Everyday application help: installation, configuration, feature use, common error messages, passwordless setup, and step-by-step instructions for end users.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast technical support target.

lanes.name: Device and network troubleshooting
lanes.description: Troubleshooting computers, operating systems, peripherals, Wi-Fi, DNS, VPN, local networks, drivers, and connectivity between devices or services.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a technical reasoning target.

lanes.name: Identity and access
lanes.description: Account provisioning, authentication, permissions, group membership, role changes, access reviews, sign-in failures, and least-privilege questions.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise security-aware target.

lanes.name: Automation
lanes.description: Creating shell commands, scripts, scheduled tasks, bulk administration, and repeatable workflows for operating systems or IT tools.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a coding target.

lanes.name: Change documentation
lanes.description: Writing runbooks, maintenance notices, asset inventories, change records, rollback steps, support handoffs, and operational procedures.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a clear technical writing target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable technical support target.

starters.name: Security Operations Desk
starters.summary: Routes alerts, threats, secure review, incidents, and compliance evidence.
starters.notice: Verify security advice before applying it.

lanes.name: Alert triage
lanes.description: Assessing alerts, logs, indicators, suspicious events, and detections to determine likely cause, affected assets, severity, confidence, and immediate next checks.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast security analysis target.

lanes.name: Threat modeling
lanes.description: Mapping assets, trust boundaries, actors, entry points, abuse cases, attack paths, existing controls, and recommended mitigations before an incident occurs.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong security reasoning target.

lanes.name: Secure review
lanes.description: Inspecting code, infrastructure, permissions, configurations, and deployment plans for vulnerabilities, unsafe defaults, secret exposure, and control gaps.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful code and configuration target.

lanes.name: Incident response
lanes.description: Active security events that need containment, evidence preservation, investigation steps, timeline reconstruction, stakeholder updates, recovery, and lessons learned.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong incident reasoning target.

lanes.name: Compliance evidence
lanes.description: Mapping supplied policies, controls, tests, findings, owners, and remediation records to an audit, certification, or governance requirement.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise long-context target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable security reasoning target.

starters.name: DevOps and Reliability
starters.summary: Routes builds, infrastructure, observability, incidents, and performance.

lanes.name: Build and CI failures
lanes.description: Failures in builds, tests, dependencies, package resolution, CI jobs, artifacts, signing, or release pipelines where the goal is to restore a passing delivery path.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a coding target with strong debugging.

lanes.name: Infrastructure
lanes.description: Designing or changing containers, Kubernetes, cloud resources, networking, service discovery, infrastructure as code, and deployment topology.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong infrastructure target.

lanes.name: Observability
lanes.description: Working with logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alert rules, service objectives, error budgets, and instrumentation needed to understand system behavior.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an analytical operations target.

lanes.name: Incident mitigation
lanes.description: Live service degradation or outages that require rapid diagnosis, safe mitigation, rollback, traffic control, communication, and recovery verification.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful operations reasoning target.

lanes.name: Capacity and performance
lanes.description: Analyzing latency, throughput, saturation, resource use, scaling limits, load tests, capacity forecasts, resilience, and infrastructure cost efficiency.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a deep technical reasoning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable operations target.

starters.name: Finance and Business Analysis
starters.summary: Routes reconciliation, budgets, forecasts, pricing, and reports.
starters.notice: Review financial work before relying on it.

lanes.name: Transactions and reconciliation
lanes.description: Operational accounting work involving transaction classification, account matching, discrepancies, missing records, exception queues, and reconciliation controls.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise structured-data target.

lanes.name: Budget and variance
lanes.description: Comparing budget or plan with actual results, quantifying material differences, tracing their drivers, and explaining favorable or unfavorable variance.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a quantitative analysis target.

lanes.name: Forecast and scenarios
lanes.description: Projecting revenue, cost, cash, demand, or runway under explicit assumptions, ranges, sensitivities, and best-, base-, and worst-case scenarios.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong quantitative reasoning target.

lanes.name: Pricing and unit economics
lanes.description: Unit economics and commercial decisions involving price, margin, discounts, acquisition cost, retention, contribution, payback, and break-even.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a business reasoning target.

lanes.name: Management reporting
lanes.description: Turning financial or operating results into decision-ready tables, commentary, trends, exceptions, and an executive summary for a reporting period.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a clear analytical writing target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable quantitative reasoning target.

starters.name: Contract and Policy Review
starters.summary: Routes summaries, clauses, comparisons, drafts, and risk checks.
starters.notice: Have a qualified person review legal decisions.

lanes.name: Plain-language summary
lanes.description: Explaining a supplied contract or policy in plain language, organized around purpose, parties, obligations, dates, money, termination, and practical consequences.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful long-context target.

lanes.name: Clause extraction
lanes.description: Locating and listing specific terms such as duties, renewal, notice, payment, confidentiality, liability, data use, remedies, exceptions, and governing law.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise extraction target.

lanes.name: Version comparison
lanes.description: Comparing drafts or policy versions to identify added, removed, or changed language and explain which obligations or rights materially moved.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-context target.

lanes.name: Routine drafting
lanes.description: Drafting or revising a clause, notice, internal policy, amendment, or standard agreement language from supplied business instructions.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful drafting target.

lanes.name: Risk checklist
lanes.description: Issue spotting for ambiguity, one-sided terms, missing protections, unusual obligations, conflicting clauses, operational burden, and questions for qualified review.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a critical reasoning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a careful long-context target.

starters.name: Learning Tutor
starters.summary: Routes explanations, worked problems, practice, feedback, and study plans.

lanes.name: Explain a concept
lanes.description: Teaching a topic at the learner's stated level through definitions, intuition, examples, analogies, and checks for understanding rather than solving an assigned problem.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a clear teaching target.

lanes.name: Work through a problem
lanes.description: Guiding a specific exercise or calculation with hints, intermediate steps, reasoning, and error correction while keeping the learner engaged in the solution.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong reasoning target.

lanes.name: Practice and quiz
lanes.description: Generating practice questions, quizzes, flashcards, drills, answer keys, and spaced review prompts for a named topic or exam.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast interactive teaching target.

lanes.name: Review my work
lanes.description: Evaluating the learner's submitted answer, essay, code, or reasoning against criteria and giving specific corrections and next improvements.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful review target.

lanes.name: Study planning
lanes.description: Building a learning plan around goals, current level, available time, topic sequence, practice mix, review intervals, milestones, and progress checks.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a dependable planning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a supportive teaching target.

starters.name: Course and Training Designer
starters.summary: Routes curricula, lessons, assessments, rubrics, and learner needs.

lanes.name: Curriculum design
lanes.description: Structuring a full course or training program through audience needs, outcomes, prerequisites, modules, sequencing, duration, and evidence of mastery.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong instructional planning target.

lanes.name: Lesson creation
lanes.description: Creating one lesson or session with an opening, explanation, examples, activities, discussion prompts, timing, materials, and facilitator guidance.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a clear teaching and writing target.

lanes.name: Assessments
lanes.description: Designing quizzes, exams, practical tasks, projects, simulations, answer keys, and scoring plans that measure stated learning outcomes.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise teaching target.

lanes.name: Rubrics and feedback
lanes.description: Defining observable evaluation criteria, performance levels, scoring guidance, and reusable feedback tied to the work being assessed.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a structured review target.

lanes.name: Adaptation
lanes.description: Adjusting learning material for different skill levels, accessibility needs, languages, delivery formats, time limits, or individual support requirements.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a flexible instructional target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable instructional design target.

starters.name: Healthcare Operations Assistant
starters.summary: Routes patient administration, approved materials, documentation, policy, and operations.
starters.notice: Do not use this route for diagnosis or treatment decisions.

lanes.name: Patient administration
lanes.description: Non-clinical patient operations such as scheduling, intake, reminders, referrals, registration, forms, contact instructions, and service navigation.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a clear administrative writing target.

lanes.name: Patient-friendly materials
lanes.description: Rewriting approved health information for patients using plain language, accessible structure, appropriate reading level, and no new clinical claims.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful plain-language target.

lanes.name: Documentation formatting
lanes.description: Organizing supplied notes into a requested structure, template, or summary while preserving facts and avoiding diagnosis, treatment, or invented details.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise structured-writing target.

lanes.name: Policy and compliance
lanes.description: Summarizing supplied healthcare procedures, privacy requirements, checklists, roles, controls, and evidence needed for operational compliance.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful long-context target.

lanes.name: Operations analysis
lanes.description: Analyzing staffing, appointments, wait times, throughput, handoffs, capacity, service quality, and workflow bottlenecks in healthcare delivery operations.
lanes.target_hint: Best with an analytical reasoning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a careful healthcare operations target.

starters.name: E-commerce Operations
starters.summary: Routes catalog data, product content, merchandising, customers, and reviews.

lanes.name: Catalog cleanup
lanes.description: Normalizing product titles, categories, variants, attributes, units, identifiers, and structured fields so catalog records are consistent and complete.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a precise structured-data target.

lanes.name: Product content
lanes.description: Writing product descriptions, feature and benefit copy, specifications, comparison tables, buying guidance, and product-specific FAQs.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a clear product-writing target.

lanes.name: Merchandising
lanes.description: Planning collections, bundles, cross-sells, promotions, seasonal assortments, placement, and offer structure to improve product discovery and sales.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a creative commerce target.

lanes.name: Customer messages
lanes.description: Customer-facing replies about products, orders, shipping, delivery, returns, exchanges, stock, and post-purchase concerns.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast customer communication target.

lanes.name: Review analysis
lanes.description: Mining customer reviews for repeated praise, objections, defects, unmet expectations, language customers use, and opportunities for product or content changes.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a long-context target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable commerce writing target.

starters.name: Home, Travel, and Life Planner
starters.summary: Routes trips, purchases, home routines, events, and life administration.

lanes.name: Travel planning
lanes.description: Trips and outings involving destinations, routes, schedules, lodging, activities, reservations, packing, budgets, constraints, and backup options.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a strong planning target.

lanes.name: Purchase decisions
lanes.description: Comparing products or services against requirements, budget, trade-offs, ownership costs, compatibility, condition, and a reasoned shortlist.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a careful comparison target.

lanes.name: Home routines
lanes.description: Recurring household work such as meal planning, cleaning, maintenance, organization, chores, supplies, and schedules shared across a home.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a fast practical planning target.

lanes.name: Events and occasions
lanes.description: Planning gatherings, celebrations, and occasions through guest needs, invitations, venue, timeline, menu, activities, responsibilities, budget, and contingency plans.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a creative planning target.

lanes.name: Life administration
lanes.description: Coordinating forms, appointments, correspondence, deadlines, records, renewals, and multi-step personal tasks that do not fit travel, shopping, home, or events.
lanes.target_hint: Best with a dependable structured-planning target.

fallback.target_hint: Best with a dependable general planning target.
